context_compaction_guard.purpose: Prevent resumed Codex runs from continuing an older task variant or stale Accepted Yellow closeout after context compaction.
context_compaction_guard.resume_rule: On resume or compaction, newest user instruction wins over summaries, memory, older Linear comments, and earlier task variants.
required_resume_checks: Read the latest user-visible task request before editing or closing out.
Run git status --short --branch and inspect the current diff before editing or committing.
Run python3 scripts/ambitions-accepted-yellow-misuse-audit.py --json before any remediation closeout.
Refresh Linear statuses for AMB-1666, AMB-1667, AMB-1668, AMB-1719, AMB-1730, AMB-1731, and AMB-1732 before making tracker claims.
Do not continue M03, M08 broad work, M09, M10, M11, M12, or M13 from a compacted summary unless the newest user request explicitly asks for it.
blocked_resume_patterns: Continuing the superseded progress-integrity task when the active task is Accepted Yellow misuse repair.
Reporting M02 as complete because a prior summary says administrative completion.
Closing AMB-1666, AMB-1667, AMB-1668, or AMB-1719 from docs/audits alone.
Treating AMB-1730, AMB-1731, or AMB-1732 as optional follow-ups instead of blockers.
